querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      type,
                                      s_dq_open,
                                      s_dq_high,
                                      s_dq_low,
                                      s_dq_close,
                                      s_dq_preclose,
                                      wa_netprice,
                                      wa_prenetprice,
                                      s_dq_volume,
                                      s_dq_amount,
                                      s_dq_pctchange,
                                      s_dq_openyield,
                                      s_dq_highyield,
                                      s_dq_lowyield,
                                      s_dq_closeyield,
                                      s_dq_precloseyield,
                                      wa_yield,
                                      wa_preyield,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cfetseodprice.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cfetseodprice WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
